title.en: AN ACT EXTENDING UNTIL THE FIRST DAY OF MARCH, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND TWO, THE TIME FOR COMPLETING THE LISTING AND VALUING OF THE REAL ESTATE OF THE CITY OF

text.en:
The date fixed by section fifty-one of Act Numbered One hundred and eighty-three, incorporation
the city of Manila, for the completion by the City Assessor and Collector of the listing and valuation of all
real estate situated within said city, and by section one of Act Numbered Three hundred and twenty-three
amendatory thereof, is hereby further postponed until the first day of March, nineteen hundred and two, so
that such listing and valuation is required to be completed on or before that date.

The time within which publication shall be made informing the public that the list has been
completed and is on file in the office of the City Assessor and Collector and may be examined by any person
interested therein at a date fixed in the notice, shall for the year nineteen hundred an two be extended from
the fifteenth day of March, nineteen hundred and two, and section fifty-six of said Act nineteen hundred and
two shall meet on the second Monday in April instead of the second Monday in January, as now provided in
said section.

The amendments of Act Numbered One hundred and eighty-three made in sections one and two
hereof shall only be applicable to the taxes assessed for the year nineteen hundred and one, and the sections
so amended shall remain in full force, as to the assessment of taxes for all succeeding years, as they now are
in said Act Numbered One hundred and eighty-three.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 4, 1902.
